scheme: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students

rules.name: Parental Annual Income Ceiling
rules.description: Total parental/guardian annual income must not exceed statutory ceiling.
rules.statutoryReference: MoTA Post-Matric ST Scheme Guidelines Section 4.2

rules.name: State Scheduled Tribe Schedule Verification
rules.description: Tribe stated on certificate must match the Scheduled Tribe Schedule of the issuing State. AI checks consistency/validity; it never decides tribe status.

rules.name: Income Certificate Freshness Window
rules.description: Income certificates must be issued within the state-mandated validity period (12 months in Jharkhand).

rules.name: Applicant Identity Fuzzy Consistency
rules.description: Applicant Name and Father/Guardian Name on certificate must match application form within fuzzy match tolerance (Levenshtein similarity >= 0.85).
rules.statutoryReference: Aadhaar e-KYC and Certificate Matching Standard v2.1

rules.name: Bank Account Multi-Applicant Clustering
rules.description: Detects if a single bank account or IFSC is linked to multiple unrelated applicants across institutes.
